title: fix(plugin-list): Refresh alone no longer draws the Display entry in the default list toolbar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_
Fixes #36002

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表默认工具栏里，看板、日历这类视图如果除了刷新外没有别的显示选项，就不再出现一个点开只有底栏的空「显示」入口；宽工具栏的刷新按钮照旧。
- 属于「列表页重做」专题：两行工具栏按「刷新去掉」落地后剩下的收尾。
- 出错时最坏是这类视图少了「显示」入口，而它本来就没有可用的选项；改动小，可整体撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: `displayOffered` no longer ORs `toolbarFlags.showRefresh`. The default (Display) toolbar has no Refresh since the two-row toolbar landed, neither on the bar nor in the panel (`viewSettingsElement` is handed no refresh prop), so the key was the only reason a non-grid view with every other Display control off drew a Display entry that opened onto just the footer. The stale Refresh comment ("in the Display form it sits in the panel's footer") now says Refresh is wide-form only.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: the `userActions.refresh` describe says the toggle governs only the wide toolbar's Refresh (`compactToolbar: false`) and changes nothing in the default toolbar. Description text only: key, type and default unchanged; no retirement (card item 2, first branch, per the claim).
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`: the form hint for `userActions.refresh` mirrors the new describe. Required, not chosen: `src/ui/view-form-composite-children.test.ts` pins every `userActions` hint equal to the schema description it replaces, and went red without it.
- Regenerated, never hand-edited: `content/docs/references/ui/{view,page}.mdx` (`check:generated --fix`, which named only `check:docs` stale) and `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects`; the other ten locales keep their hand-written translations, no source-hash entries exist for this leaf).
- Pin: a new top-level block `ListView.refreshOnlyDisplay-36002` in the shared `ListView.harness.test.tsx` (the harness rule: a ListView pin that needs no `vi.mock` joins that file). A kanban view with Group, Row height and Hide fields off and `refresh` at its default draws no `toolbar-display-trigger`; CONTROLS: `compactToolbar: false` still draws `refresh-button`, and the same view with Row height on draws the Display entry.
- Changeset `.changeset/36002-refresh-display-panel.md`: patch for `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, the `displayOffered` hunk: the one behaviour change.
2. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, the `refresh` describe: a published-schema text face (contract review on record before landing).
3. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx`, the new block at the end.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance 1 ("A view whose only display option was Refresh no longer opens an empty Display panel in the default toolbar"): pinned by the new block, ablation red without the fix. Only non-grid views can reach it: the grid always offers Display (`currentView === 'grid'`, its columns).
- Card acceptance 2 ("The key's describe matches what it does"): describe, form hint and generated references now say wide-toolbar only.
- Skills/docs measured for text claiming `userActions.refresh` governs the default toolbar: zero hits in `skills/**`, `content/docs/**` (outside `references/` and `releases/`) and `ui/**/*.md`; control term `userActions.editInline` hits `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`. No stale text to name.
- Noted, not filed: the ten translated locales of the `userActions.refresh` form hint still carry only the first sentence (still true, now less precise than English). Translation is a translator's edit, outside this card.
- Noted, not filed: the spec describe of `compactToolbar` ("Collapse Group/Color/Density/Hide-fields into a single View settings popover") does not say that collapsing is the renderer default (`schema.compactToolbar !== false`) nor that Refresh is dropped; observation only.
- File surface beyond the first claim: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts` and the regenerated `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, both forced by the hint pin above; the seat amends the claim.
- Overlap: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` re-run at `75244b31`: VERDICT clean against `origin/main` b3bcfefcb8 and #36343 (shares `ListView.tsx`), merges cleanly. Earlier run: clean against #36223 (since merged).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.harness.test.tsx -t refreshOnlyDisplay-36002` shows 3 passed. In the Console, a kanban list view with `userActions: { group: false, rowHeight: false, hideFields: false }` shows no Display button beside the view name; set `compactToolbar: false` and the Refresh button appears on the bar.
